excerpt.zh:
我们的天文学家们十分确信，这个星系的小行星带曾经是一颗宜居的行星，但是却被某种未知的力量击碎了。

已发起特殊项目来进一步研究小行星带中的主要天体。
excerpt.en:
Our astronomers are confident that the asteroid belt in this system was once a habitable planet, torn asunder by unknown forces.

A Special Project has been issued to study one of the major asteroids in the belt.

Our astronomers are confident that the asteroid belt in this system was once a habitable planet, torn asunder by unknown forces.

A Special Project has been issued to study one of the major asteroids in the belt.

texts.zh:
在围绕这颗恒星运转的行星中，其中一颗还清晰地留有灾难的痕迹。这颗行星的地表被半融未融的矿物海洋所覆盖着，大气炽热无比。然而[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]天文学家们却声称这里可能曾经出现过生命。

已发起特殊项目来进一步研究这颗炽热的行星。
texts.en:
One of the planets orbiting this star bears the still-open wounds of some past calamity. Its surface is a roiling sea of half-melted minerals boiling into a superheated atmosphere, but [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] astronomers claim that it may once have supported life.

A Special Project has been issued to study the molten planet.

label.en: It lies within foreign territory. Find another subject.

texts.zh:
在这个星系里，有一颗行星以往生态圈所留下的化石痕迹依然清晰可见。是什么把欣欣向荣的生物圈变成了一片不毛之地？

已发起特殊项目来研究这一灾难性转变的成因。
texts.en:
A planet in this system still wears the fossilized traces of a past ecology on its sleeve. What could turn a thriving biosphere into a blasted wasteland?

A Special Project has been issued to trace the source of this disastrous transformation.

texts.zh:
据称，这颗行星上的动植物会释放有毒气体使其他物种窒息，或许这是地壳之下在不断涌出的活性气体造成的。

已发起特殊项目来研究这一现象。
texts.en:
Allegedly this planet's flora and fauna choked on their own poisonous emissions, likely helped along by the release of reactive gases from beneath the planet's crust.

A Special Project has been issued to investigate the matter.

texts.zh:
这个星系中有一颗奇怪的行星，星球表面被一层又一层成分各异的寒冰所覆盖。可推测，这颗星球曾有过种类繁杂的生物群。

已发起特殊项目来调查这一可能性。
texts.en:
The planet of interest in this system is covered in layer upon layer of dense ices of varying composition. Apparently it was once home to more varied and pleasant biomes.

A Special Project has been issued to investigate this possibility.

label.zh: 目标位于别国领域。请另寻目标。
label.en: It lies within foreign territory. Find another subject.

texts.zh:
这颗小星球其实曾是一颗宜居——或许甚至有人居住过——的行星的一部分。其破裂形态富有规律但又相互重叠，可以看出这颗星球的毁灭是预先设计好的，尽管实施的时可能有些匆忙。

所有的迹象都表明，这颗星球曾是某个物种的母星，但这个物种最后又摧毁了它。我们可能永远都不会知道是什么驱使它们做出毁灭星球这种行为，但是我们也许该为此感到庆幸。
texts.en:
The asteroid is in actuality a chunk of what was once a habitable, and probably inhabited, planet. Regular but overlapping fracture patterns indicate that the planetary demolition was intentional and controlled, if somewhat rushed.

All signs point to this planet being the homeworld of whatever species destroyed it. We may never know what drove them to consider planetary annihilation to be the lesser evil, and perhaps we should be grateful for that.

texts.zh:
这颗星球的悲惨命运可以归结于宇宙的喜怒无常。

我们科学家认为，一个由短暂时空异常导致的引力扰动，迫使这颗星球的轨道变得过于接近恒星。尽管它在缓慢地向自己的原有轨道作螺旋式运动，但仍是不断受到恒星的余热炙烤。
texts.en:
The unfortunate fate of the planet can be laid squarely at the feet of cosmic whims.

A gravitational disturbance, which our scientists suspect was a transient space-time anomaly, forced the planet from its natural orbit to one much too close to the sun. Although the planet is slowly spiraling back towards its original orbit, it has been cooking in the residual heat from the star ever since.

texts.zh:
对这颗荒芜的星球上曾存在过的生命，它们的命运从一开始就注定了。

主体物种甚至还来不及演化出智能、发明农业，地理机制就已经让土壤严重酸化了。

从土壤下层和化石遗骸中提取的样品表明，对土壤再生极为关键的矿物质被当地生物的内骨骼消耗殆尽。

它们的骨骼会完全石化而非腐坏，它们光是存在就已经耗竭了脆弱的生态系统，使其发生了永久性的转变。
texts.en:
Life on the now-barren planet was doomed from the start.

The dominant species barely had time to awaken to sapience and invent agriculture before geological mechanisms caused the earth to sour.

Samples from lower soil strata and fossilized remains show that vital minerals needed to rejuvenate the soil ended up in the endoskeletons of the native beings.

Their bones fossilized instead of decaying, and their existence exhausted the fragile ecosystem, leaving it permanently transformed.

texts.zh:
我们一度以为行星地壳上的千沟万壑是由地质活动塑造的，然而它们实际上却是破土而入的巨大根茎所遗留下来的永恒伤疤。

在过去的某一个时间点，一种可能由智慧物种引发的变异导致当地的植物开始失控疯长。在下层大气环流的帮助下，许多这样的植物借助花粉进行繁殖。

这种影响起先看似轻微，却愈演愈烈，大气层中愈发浓密的颗粒物最终在几个月内将星球上所有的动物呛死了。
texts.en:
The cracks in the planet's crust, initially thought to be caused by tectonic activity, are actually lasting marks of enormous roots burrowing through the earth.

At some point in the past, a mutation, possibly induced by sapient beings, caused the native plant life to grow uncontrollably. Many of these plants reproduce through pollination, with countless gametes carried by currents in the lower atmosphere.

What was once a mild irritation escalated, as the increase in atmosphere-borne particles choked the life out of all animals on the planet within months.

texts.zh:
大气成分的一次异常变化让这颗星球慢慢地进入了冰川期，这一过程早于[Root.Owner.GetName]的形成而且可能在我们都不在了以后仍将继续下去。

造成大气变化的确切原因尚不清楚，但是存在几种假说，例如环境改造失败或行星内恐怖主义活动等等。[Root.Owner.Capital.GetName]科学共同体内的一些激进分子甚至认为，这种急剧的气候变化可能是大肆排放工业废气导致的。

只有少数科学家赞同这一观点。毕竟一个物种如果有能力完全实现工业化，又怎么会傻到一不小心就把自己给毁灭了呢？
texts.en:
An unnatural shift in the atmosphere's chemical make-up resulted in the slow onset of an ice age, beginning before the formation of [Root.Owner.GetName] and likely persisting long after our passing.

The exact cause is unknown, but possible explanations include failed terraforming attempts or intra-planetary terrorism. Some radical elements within the scientific community on [Root.Owner.Capital.GetName] suggest that the climate shift may have been caused by the unchecked emission of industrial by-products.

This view is confined to the fringe, as it is unlikely any race intelligent enough for industrialization would be foolish enough to wipe themselves out.

texts.zh:
大气层化学成分非自然剧变导致这个星球缓慢却不可避免地进入了冰川期——这一时期在[Root.Owner.GetName]建立之前就已经开始，而且很有可能在我们灭亡之后还未结束。

因为我们自己的行星上发生过的工业化经历，我们对其原因感到相当熟悉：向大气层无休止地排放工业废气导致了剧烈的气候变化，而且他们的科技还没发展到能够解决这一问题的程度。

这一结论引起了我们科学界的一定关注，尽管多数人指出我们的科技“大概”已经发达到足以避免这种灭绝事件的程度了。
texts.en:
An unnatural shift in the atmosphere's chemical make-up resulted in the slow but irreversible onset of an ice age - one that began before the formation of the [Root.Owner.GetName] and is likely to persist long after our passing.

The cause appears familiar from our experience of industrialization on our own planets: the unchecked emission of gaseous industrial by-product into the atmosphere caused dramatic climatic shifts which they lacked the technology to counteract.

This conclusion has caused some concern among our scientific community, although most point out that at our technological level such an extinction event could "probably" be avoided.

texts.zh:
这次科研探险我们得到了许多意料之外的收获。[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]科学家现在掌握了空前庞大的数据，能够为[Root.Capital.GetName]的未来建立精确的模型。

最初的报告显示，刨除诡异的宇宙活动和[Root.GetName]的突然崩溃，[Root.Capital.GetName]至少在百年内都不会真正遇到危险。
texts.en:
While the research expedition often yielded unexpected results, [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] scientists now have access to an unprecedented wealth of data with which to accurately model the future of [Root.Capital.GetName].

Initial reports suggest that [Root.Capital.GetName] will be in no real danger for at least a dozen generations, save from freak cosmic events or the violent collapse of the [Root.GetName].

label.zh: 我们还能从这些行星上学到什么呢？
label.en: What else can we learn from these planets?
The [Root.GetSpeciesName] people should be put at ease.

texts.en: Reconstruct the traumatic past of this celestial body.
